$comment: FedRAMP Certification Reports received (CDS-CSO-FRC). Each report FedRAMP sends is committed to this directory byte for byte, as received, and listed here with the date received and its sha256. scripts/publish-certification-reports.py checks every file against its sha256 (an edited report fails the deploy), and the deploy publishes each unmodified at /.well-known/fedramp-certification-reports/<file>, indexed by the signed /.well-known/fedramp-certification-reports.json with the days from receipt to first publication (FedRAMP's window: 2 weeks). SIMULATED: this proof of concept has no FedRAMP counterpart; the one report here is a plainly fake stand-in, flagged simulated, so the path is exercised on every deploy.

reports.from: Simulated FedRAMP (no real party: the operator wrote this stand-in)
